pcs.pc_description: examine the body of the backhoe loader to check that it is free of cracks and wear
check for dents and broken welds on the boom and the stick
check differential and hydraulic oil levels
check for leaks in the hydraulic hose and ram
carry out inspections to verify that the parking brake, main horn, reverse horn, and headlight are in proper working order
check fan belt tension, electrolyte level and terminal tightness
get visual inspection conducted to check the various controls, gauges, warning lamp and other safety devices
check load chart is displayed in cabin
check and adjust the driving position, rear and side mirrors, and seat belts to your comfort level
ensure that the air filter dust bowls are clean, and that the gasket and inner filter are in good condition
drain the water and debris from the fuel tank
check to make sure coolant and oil in engine, transmission, etc. are topped up if necessary as per manufacturers indicators
inspect the greasing points to ensure that all greasing pins and pivotspoints are appropriately greased
inspect the compressor unit, as well as any fittings and air lines
check clearance of the drawbar ball and socket, look for excessive freeplay, and adjust if necessary
ensure the locking bar is in position to prevent the front and rear chassis moving and creating a crushing zone (articulated machines only)
at regular intervals, clean the footplates, pedals, and stairs of mud, grime, ice, and snow
certify that the backhoe loader has no one under or on the machine before operating
keep a checking/maintenance diary in which all actions completed prior to starting the backhoe are recorded
if a fault is found that is outside of the scope of the position, notify the operator immediately
